payload.name: BookMyDestination.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search BookMyDestination.com for tour packages and activities, compare prices, view details and day-by-day itineraries, and check selectable travel dates. The current integration is read-only and does not create bookings or take payments.
payload.longDescription: 在 BookMyDestination.com 搜索旅游套餐和活动、比较价格、查看详情及每日行程，并检查可选旅行日期。当前集成为只读，不会创建预订或收取付款。

payload.name: HOTELS Trip & Travel Stays
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HOTELS finds a stay that fits your entire trip—not just a place to sleep.

It matches stays to your itinerary: close to your activities and restaurants, within your budget, and well located so you spend your trip exploring instead of commuting. Get personalized recommendations by location, price, amenities, and vibe—from budget boutiques to full-service chains.

Don't have an itinerary yet? HOTELS can help you plan your trip around where you stay. Get a short, ranked list of options that fit your needs, with the trade-offs clearly explained—so you can decide quickly and keep planning.
payload.longDescription:
HOTELS 帮你找到适合整趟旅程的住宿，而不只是一个过夜的地方。

它会根据你的行程匹配住宿：靠近活动地点和餐厅、符合预算，位置也方便，让你把时间花在探索而非通勤上。你可以按地点、价格、设施和风格获取个性化推荐，从经济型精品酒店到全服务连锁酒店均有选择。

还没有行程？HOTELS 也能帮你围绕住宿规划旅程。它会列出简短的推荐清单，并按匹配度排序，清楚说明各选项的取舍，方便你快速决定并继续规划。

payload.name: Leave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Leave account to find the right trip, summarize upcoming plans, check itinerary times and accommodation details, understand privacy-minimized budgets, expenses, and balances, find safe document metadata, review notes and tasks, and prepare approval-required trip changes. Leave remains the source of truth, and every request respects current trip membership, roles, scopes, and privacy rules.
payload.longDescription: 将 Leave 账户连接后，即可查找合适的旅行、总结即将到来的计划、查看行程时间和住宿详情、了解尽量减少隐私信息的预算、支出和余额、查找安全的文档元数据、查看备注和任务，并准备需要审批的行程变更。Leave 始终是权威数据源；每项请求都会遵守当前旅行成员身份、角色、权限范围和隐私规则。

payload.name: FREETOUR.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and book free walking tours, guided experiences, activities, day trips, and attraction tickets around the world with FREETOUR.com.

Explore more than 21000 tours, activities, and attractions across 2200 destinations in 150 countries.

Search by destination, date, language, price, rating, or tour type. Compare options, check availability, and explore tour details, schedules, meeting points, reviews, and pricing.

From tip-based free walking tours with local guides to food tours, cruises, nature experiences, day trips, and paid attractions, FREETOUR.com helps you find things to do that fit your trip, interests, and budget.
payload.longDescription:
通过 FREETOUR.com，探索并预订全球各地的免费徒步游、导览体验、活动、一日游和景点门票。

探索遍布 150 个国家、2200 个目的地的 21000 多项旅游线路、活动和景点。

可按目的地、日期、语言、价格、评分或旅游类型搜索。比较不同选项、查看空位，并了解行程详情、时间安排、集合地点、评价和价格。

从依靠小费的当地向导免费徒步游，到美食之旅、游船、自然体验、一日游和收费景点，FREETOUR.com 帮你根据行程、兴趣和预算找到合适的活动。

payload.name: AuroraReach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AuroraReach helps you plan when and where to see the northern lights using live aurora conditions, forecasts, viewing recommendations, historical activity and recent community sightings.

Ask about conditions in a specific city, compare nearby viewing locations, find the best time to go out, or plan an aurora evening. AuroraReach can also surface relevant tours and activities from GetYourGuide and Viator when available.
payload.longDescription:
AuroraReach 利用实时极光状况、预报、观赏建议、历史活动和社区近期目击记录，帮助你规划何时、何地观赏北极光。

询问特定城市的状况、比较附近的观赏地点、寻找最佳外出时间，或规划一个观赏极光的夜晚。AuroraReach 还可以在有相关信息时提供 GetYourGuide 和 Viator 的相关旅行团及活动。

payload.name: Concierge Radar
payload.description: 为你和你的客户提供旅行服务
payload.summaryOriginal: Viajes para ti y tus clientes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cotiza hospedaje con tarifas reales de Concierge Radar, compara opciones y crea borradores y ligas de propuestas para tus clientes desde ChatGPT. Requiere una cuenta registrada de Concierge Radar. No reserva, compra ni envía mensajes automáticamente.
payload.longDescription: 通过Concierge Radar的真实价格报价住宿，比较选项并创建草案和提案链接，所有操作均可通过ChatGPT完成。需要注册Concierge Radar账户。不提供预订、购买或自动发送消息功能。

payload.name: WAS Travel Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WAS Travel Insurance helps users compare Australian travel-insurance plans and prices for single trips or annual multi-trip cover, including optional cover preferences and purchase links.
payload.longDescription: WAS Travel Insurance 帮助用户比较澳大利亚旅行保险计划和价格，涵盖单次旅行或全年多次旅行保障，包括可选保障偏好和购买链接。

payload.name: AgentRoam
payload.description: 用加密货币购买旅行 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgentRoam helps travelers find and buy travel eSIM data plans with stablecoins and crypto. Choose your destination, compare available plans, pay from your wallet, and receive your eSIM setup details by email after checkout.

You can also explore crypto-friendly travel gift cards and airtime top-ups. AgentRoam is built for both travelers and AI agents, with MCP support for searching destinations, comparing plans, preparing checkout quotes, and tracking order status with user confirmation before purchase.
payload.longDescription:
AgentRoam 帮助旅行者使用稳定币和加密货币查找并购买旅行 eSIM 流量套餐。选择目的地，比较可用套餐，通过钱包支付，结账后通过电子邮件接收 eSIM 设置详情。

你还可以探索支持加密货币的旅行礼品卡和话费充值。AgentRoam 同时面向旅行者和 AI 智能体，提供 MCP 支持，用于搜索目的地、比较套餐、准备结账报价和跟踪订单状态，购买前需要用户确认。

payload.name: SeeyaTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Seeyatrip hotel catalog and cite hotels with booking links on the traveller's own dates.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 Seeyatrip 酒店目录，并根据旅客自己的日期引用带有预订链接的酒店。

payload.name: Frip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover unique local experiences in Korea with Frip. Find and book activities, one-day classes, social gatherings, and hobby experiences across Korea—all in one place.

Explore things to do by interest, location, and budget, from baking, crafts, wine, fitness, and outdoor adventures to dating events, local meetups, wellness, and travel activities.

Whether you’re planning a weekend in Seoul, looking for something special in Jeju or Busan, or searching for last-minute ideas nearby, Frip helps you discover memorable ways to spend your time.
payload.longDescription:
通过 Frip 探索韩国独特的本地体验。在韩国各地查找并预订活动、单日课程、社交聚会和兴趣体验，一站式完成。

按兴趣、地点和预算探索活动，内容包括烘焙、手工艺、葡萄酒、健身、户外探险、约会活动、本地聚会、健康体验和旅行活动。

无论你计划在首尔度过周末、想在济州岛或釜山寻找特别体验，还是临时想找附近的活动，Frip 都能帮你发现值得回味的消遣方式。

payload.name: Scioperi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check the calendar of scheduled strikes in Italy in real time, directly from your AI chat. The plugin connects to public strike data and lets you search strikes by sector (transport, schools, healthcare, etc.) and by region, with date-range filters.

Just ask "are there any transport strikes this week?" or "what strikes are planned in Lombardy next month?" to get an up-to-date, paginated, easy-to-browse list.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 AI 聊天中实时查看意大利计划中的罢工日历。该插件连接公共罢工数据，可按行业（交通、学校、医疗等）和地区搜索罢工，并按日期范围筛选。

只需询问“本周有交通罢工吗？”或“下个月伦巴第有哪些计划中的罢工？”，即可获得最新的分页列表，便于浏览。

payload.name: Sail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sail makes transportation choices simpler and more transparent. Find places and compare estimated prices, pickup times, and availability across ride-hailing services in 24+ countries. Where public transport coverage is available, Sail can also plan journeys with fares, walking directions, transfers, and boarding guidance. Compare available options for the same trip and choose what works best for you. Sail is read-only and does not book, track, or cancel rides. Results are estimates and may change before travel.
payload.longDescription: Sail 让交通选择更简单、更透明。在 24+ 个国家/地区查找地点，并比较网约车服务的预估价格、接驾时间和可用情况。在覆盖公共交通的地区，Sail 还可规划行程，提供票价、步行路线、换乘和乘车指引。比较同一行程的可用方案，选择最适合你的方式。Sail 为只读服务，不会预订、追踪或取消行程。结果为预估值，出行前可能会发生变化。

payload.name: Parks n Paws
payload.description: 查找可携狗入住的公园周边住宿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parks n Paws helps travelers find hand-reviewed dog-friendly hotels near US national parks. Each listing highlights practical pet-policy details such as fees, weight limits, breed restrictions, location, and dog-friendly amenities. We include honest pros and cons plus local tips like nearby vets, dog-friendly dining, and the best season to visit. The directory covers more than 1,300 hotels across 60 US national parks and 25 other iconic parks and monuments.
payload.longDescription: Parks n Paws 帮助旅客查找美国国家公园附近经过人工审核、允许携狗入住的酒店。每条房源都会突出实用的宠物政策信息，例如费用、体重限制、品种限制、地点和适合狗狗的设施。我们会提供客观的优缺点，以及附近兽医、可携狗用餐场所和最佳游览季节等本地建议。该目录涵盖 60 个美国国家公园和另外 25 个知名公园及纪念地周边的 1,300 多家酒店。

payload.name: How is my trip?
payload.description: 实时旅行中断风险监测
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: How is my trip? assesses travel disruption risk for a destination and date window, monitors trips for material changes, explains quiet periods, and provides current event and tourism context from published official-source data.
payload.longDescription: How is my trip? 会评估某个目的地在指定日期范围内的旅行受扰风险，监测旅程中的重大变化，解释平静期，并根据已发布的官方来源数据提供当前事件和旅游背景信息。

payload.name: MapQuest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get driving directions between any two addresses, with current traffic factored into your estimated arrival time. Search for restaurants, shops, services and other places near a location, and see how far away each one is. Look up the exact coordinates for an address, or find the nearest address for a set of coordinates. Running errands or making deliveries? Give MapQuest your list of stops and it will work out the most efficient order to visit them. Traffic incidents and construction along your route are flagged so you know what to expect before you leave.
payload.longDescription: 获取任意两个地址之间的驾车路线，预计到达时间会考虑当前交通状况。搜索某地点附近的餐馆、商店、服务和其他场所，并查看距离。查询地址的精确坐标，或根据一组坐标查找最近的地址。要跑腿或安排配送？把停靠点列表交给 MapQuest，它会计算最高效的访问顺序。路线上的交通事故和道路施工也会标记出来，让你出发前了解情况。

payload.name: tabiori
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tabiori helps travelers create and update shareable trip plans from ChatGPT conversations. After users connect their tabiori account with OAuth, the plugin can create a saved travel plan, add or update itineraries, schedules, checklists, notes, scraps, chat messages, images, hotel candidates, and sharing links. Changes are saved to the user's tabiori account so the plan can be opened and shared in tabiori.
payload.longDescription: tabiori 帮助旅行者根据 ChatGPT 对话创建和更新可分享的旅行计划。用户通过 OAuth 连接 tabiori 账户后，插件可以创建并保存旅行计划，添加或更新行程、日程、清单、笔记、素材片段、聊天消息、图片、酒店候选项和分享链接。更改会保存到用户的 tabiori 账户中，因此可以在 tabiori 中打开并分享计划。

payload.name: Aman
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the world of Aman. Plan your stay, explore destinations and learn about dining, wellness and cultural experiences crafted by Aman. Check available rooms and rates for preferred dates and review your selected stay before continuing to Aman’s booking site to reserve. Please note, reservations are not completed within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 探索 Aman 的世界。规划住宿、探索目的地，了解 Aman 精心打造的餐饮、康养和文化体验。查询心仪日期的空房和价格，查看所选住宿，然后前往 Aman 预订网站完成预订。请注意，预订不会在 ChatGPT 内完成。

payload.name: Musafir.com: Visa & Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.
payload.longDescription:
Musafir.com Visa 根据 Musafir.com 的实时产品目录回答签证问题：是否需要签证、费用、所需文件、处理时间，以及 Musafir.com 是否可以代办。若签证需要现场预约，还会显示已公布可用性的签证中心及其最近一次显示为开放的日期，让你在做决定前大致了解现实可行的时间。

签证规则、费用和处理时间不断变化，也因护照不同而异，因此记忆中的或公开发布的数字通常已不适用于提问者。这里的每个答案都来自为 Musafir.com 自有预订定价的目录，并注明适用市场。

你可以询问目的地、比较多个目的地，或确认所需材料及每份文件的提交方式（在线上传、带到签证中心或通过快递）。准备申请时，应用会把你的详细信息带到 Musafir.com 的匹配页面；申请提交后，Musafir.com

会为你预约。
Musafir.com 目前服务从阿联酋申请的旅行者。如果你居住地尚未覆盖，连接器会明确说明，而不会为你无法使用的流程报价。

此连接器为只读。它无法访问账户、查看或修改订单、锁定或预约，也不能收款。预约可用性是签证中心最近公布的信息，不是预订，也不是保证。它说明 Musafir.com 能办理的事项，这不等同于政府要求，也绝不预测签证是否获批。

payload.name: The Visa Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Visa Services answers your visa questions from the internal knowledge base: which countries and visa types are available, processing times, fees, required documents and application requirements. 
Ask in any language and get the answer in the same language. 
If the question needs more detail, the plugin asks which country or visa type you mean.
payload.longDescription:
签证服务通过内部知识库为您解答签证相关问题，包括可办理国家及签证类型、处理时间、费用、所需文件和申请要求。
支持多种语言提问，系统将使用相同语言作答。
若问题需要更多细节，插件会询问您具体指哪个国家或签证类型。

payload.name: JPS — Award Search & Watch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JPS by BookLikeJoël lets connected members search live award-flight availability, review mileage-program results, and manage private JPS flight watches from ChatGPT. JPS does not book, hold, reserve, or issue tickets, and it never fabricates live inventory, mileage prices, taxes, seat counts, schedules, airlines, or booking links.
payload.longDescription: JPS by BookLikeJoël 让已连接的会员搜索实时奖励机票可用性、查看里程计划结果并管理私人航班关注。JPS 不会预订、保留、锁定或出票，也不会虚构实时库存、里程价格、税费、座位数、时刻、航空公司或预订链接。

payload.name: StayFritz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StayFritz helps travelers discover vacation rentals and hotels, check available stays, and continue to a secure booking flow. Search by destination, dates, number of guests, and travel preferences, then view property details, prices, amenities, and booking options. Final availability and payment are confirmed during checkout on StayFritz.
payload.longDescription: StayFritz 帮助旅行者发现度假租赁房和酒店、查看可入住选项，并继续进入安全预订流程。按目的地、日期、人数和旅行偏好搜索，然后查看房源详情、价格、设施和预订选项。最终的房态和付款将在 StayFritz 结账时确认。

payload.name: Roam Rule
payload.description: 查看税务与签证停留限制
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

The mobile app keeps your travel record up to date in the background, shows where you have been on a map and helps you stay ahead of tax residency, Schengen 90/180, visa and time-away limits, custom limits, alerts, tax signals and days needing review.

In ChatGPT, you can ask plain-English questions about your Roam Rule record before booking a trip, checking a Schengen stay, preparing for an adviser call or setting up a regular check-in. Ask about logged countries, current counters, upcoming thresholds and unresolved travel days, then get a quick visual summary of what needs attention next.

With Roam Rule in ChatGPT you can:

- check where your travel days are adding up before booking a trip
- ask what to review before another Schengen or visa-sensitive journey
- use a planned itinerary in the conversation to ask what counters you should check first
- prepare a quick summary before speaking to an accountant, adviser or immigration professional
- set a regular ChatGPT check-in to remind you to review your Roam Rule counters and days needing attention
payload.longDescription:
Roam Rule 是一款税务居民身份追踪和旅行天数限制应用，适用于外籍人士、创始人、顾问、机组人员及经常旅行者，帮助他们可靠记录各地停留天数的累计情况。

移动应用会在后台更新你的旅行记录，在地图上显示你去过的地方，并帮助你关注税务居民身份、申根 90/180 天规则、签证和离境时长限制、自定义限制、提醒、税务提示以及待审核天数。

在 ChatGPT 中，你可以在预订行程、核对申根停留、准备与顾问通话或设置定期检查前，用通俗语言询问 Roam Rule 记录。你可以询问已记录的国家、当前计数、即将达到的阈值和未解决的旅行天数，并快速获取可视化摘要，了解接下来需要关注什么。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Roam Rule，你可以：

- 在预订行程前查看旅行天数累计到了哪些地方
- 询问再次申根旅行或签证敏感行程前需要核查什么
- 在对话中提供计划行程，询问应先检查哪些计数
- 在联系会计师、顾问或移民专业人士前准备简要摘要
- 设置定期 ChatGPT 检查，提醒你查看 Roam Rule 计数及需要关注的天数

payload.name: Radisson Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?

When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
该插件发现并规划住宿。以下功能和限制适用：

Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?
When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.

payload.name: RegioJet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your companion for travel with RegioJet. Skip the complex search filters. Just type where you want to go, and it handles the rest: find the best routes and book your tickets instantly in one seamless conversation.
payload.longDescription: RegioJet 出行好帮手。无需使用复杂的搜索筛选器，只需输入目的地，其余交给它处理：通过一次流畅的对话查找最佳路线并即时预订车票。

payload.name: Zuzli
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zuzli helps travelers create, validate, view, and update day-by-day itineraries, including stops, routes, schedules, and live trip progress.
payload.longDescription: Zuzli 帮助旅行者创建、验证、查看和更新逐日行程，包括停靠点、路线、时间安排和实时行程进度。

payload.name: Sóley
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sóley is Iceland's tourism operator registry and live travel intelligence service. It searches Iceland's official licensed operator registers for accommodation providers, day tour operators and travel agencies across the country, with source attribution and freshness for every record. Registry listings are informational and are not automatically bookable. Only two clearly marked demonstration operators are currently bookable through Sóley. No real operator is currently bookable.

Sóley provides live Iceland conditions from authoritative sources, including weather, road conditions, safety alerts, earthquakes, aurora forecasts, avalanche conditions, air quality, flights, fuel prices, exchange rates, news and public transit. Curated multi-day itineraries, developed in collaboration with local tourism bodies in Iceland, connect routes to licensed operators near each stop.

Tourism operators are independent businesses that set their own terms and use their own payment providers. Each operator remains the merchant of record. Sóley is never the merchant of record, never receives traveler funds and never becomes a party to the traveler and operator purchase contract.
payload.longDescription:
Sóley 是冰岛旅游经营者登记查询和实时旅行信息服务。它会搜索冰岛官方许可经营者名录，查找全国各地的住宿提供者、一日游经营者和旅行社，并为每条记录注明来源和信息新鲜度。名录信息仅供参考，不能据此直接预订。目前只有两个明确标记为演示的经营者可以通过 Sóley 预订。当前没有任何真实经营者可供预订。

Sóley 提供来自权威来源的冰岛实时状况信息，包括天气、道路状况、安全警报、地震、极光预报、雪崩状况、空气质量、航班、燃油价格、汇率、新闻和公共交通。与冰岛当地旅游机构合作制定的精选多日行程，会将路线与每个停靠点附近的持牌经营者关联起来。

旅游经营者均为独立企业，自行制定条款并使用自己的支付服务商。每个经营者仍是记录在案的商家。Sóley 绝不会成为记录在案的商家，不会接收旅行者资金，也不会成为旅行者与经营者之间购买合同的一方。

payload.name: billiger-mietwagen.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare rental cars from leading providers in Germany directly from ChatGPT. Specify your destination, dates, and preferences to find the best deals. Compare prices across major rental companies, filter results by vehicle type, insurance options, and pick-up location, and get detailed offer breakdowns with pricing, terms, and conditions. Book through Billiger Mietwagen's website once you've found your rental car.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 查找和比较德国领先供应商的租车方案。说明目的地、日期和偏好，寻找最佳优惠。比较主要租车公司的价格，按车型、保险选项和取车地点筛选结果，并获取包含价格及条款条件的详细报价明细。找到合适的租赁车辆后，通过 Billiger Mietwagen 网站预订。

payload.name: VroomVroomVroom - Car Hire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: It's still VroomVroomVroom, just faster than ever — tell us where you're going and when, then we'll compare prices for you in one click.
payload.longDescription: 还是熟悉的 VroomVroomVroom，只是速度更快了——告诉我们你要去哪里、什么时候出发，我们就能一键为你比较价格。

payload.name: Houfy
payload.description: 直接寻找度假租赁房源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live Houfy vacation rentals by destination, dates, guests, price, property type, and amenities. Compare listing photos, pricing, ratings, and availability, inspect a selected property's public details, and continue to Houfy to book directly.
payload.longDescription: 按目的地、日期、人数、价格、房源类型和设施，实时搜索 Houfy 度假租赁房源。比较房源照片、价格、评分和空房情况，查看所选房源的公开详情，然后前往 Houfy 直接预订。

payload.name: ChooseCruise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChooseCruise helps users search live ocean and river cruise inventory by destination, ports, dates, cruise line, price, and duration, compare matching sailings, inspect detailed itineraries and cabin information, and continue to ChooseCruise when ready to book.
payload.longDescription: ChooseCruise 帮助用户按目的地、港口、日期、邮轮公司、价格和时长搜索实时海洋及河流邮轮库存，比较符合条件的航次，查看详细行程和舱房信息，并在准备预订时前往 ChooseCruise。

payload.name: FindCamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FindCamp gives neutral fit verdicts for European campsites, built from analysed public comments. Ask whether a specific campsite suits how you travel — family, light sleeper, beach, nature, quality, dog, or couple — and get a clear fit or no-fit, two or three reasons, and one honest tradeoff. It can also shortlist campsites for a profile or compare two side by side. FindCamp is a decision layer, not a booking site: it helps you decide, then points you to the campsite.
payload.longDescription: FindCamp 根据经过分析的公开评论，对欧洲露营地给出中立的匹配判断。你可以询问某个露营地是否符合你的旅行方式——例如适合家庭、浅眠者、海滩、自然、品质、带狗出游或情侣——并得到明确的适合或不适合结论、两到三个理由以及一项坦诚的取舍说明。它还可以根据个人需求生成露营地候选名单，或并排比较两个营地。FindCamp 是辅助决策的工具，不是预订网站：它帮助你做出选择，然后指引你前往露营地。

payload.name: Le Bon Road Trip Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Le Bon Road Trip Planner lets you find your saved trips and create or update itineraries, stops, notes, travel stories, places, photos, and budgets directly in ChatGPT. Every action is limited to the connected account, and trip-related results include a link to review changes in the Planner.
payload.longDescription: Le Bon 路程旅行规划器可让您在ChatGPT中直接查找已保存的行程，并创建或更新行程、停留点、笔记、旅行故事、地点、照片和预算。所有操作均受限于已连接的账户，与行程相关的结果会包含一个链接以便在行程规划器中查看更改。

payload.name: Yescapa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yescapa is the world's leading campervan and motorhome rental marketplace, connecting travelers with thousands of vehicles from private owners and professionals across Europe, UK, USA, Canada and Australia.

Search directly in ChatGPT: tell it where and when you want to travel, how many people are coming, and it shows available campervans and motorhomes with real prices for your dates, traveller ratings and photos. Your booking is completed securely on the Yescapa website, with your dates already filled in.
payload.longDescription:
Yescapa 是全球领先的露营车和房车租赁市场平台，为旅客对接欧洲、英国、美国、加拿大和澳大利亚的数千辆私人车主及专业运营商车辆。

payload.name: StayVisible
payload.description: 搜索租赁房源并直接预订

Tell it where you want to go, your dates, and how many guests, and it searches available properties, checks real-time availability against the host's booking calendar, returns an itemized price quote, and generates a direct booking link to the host's own site. No OTA commission, no app to install, no account required.
payload.longDescription: StayVisible 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时度假租赁房源。告诉它目的地、日期和入住人数，它就会搜索可用房源、依据房东的预订日历检查实时空房情况、返回逐项列明的价格报价，并生成指向房东自有网站的直接预订链接。无需 OTA 佣金、无需安装应用，也无需账户。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nieves Alaska Relocation helps users structure an Alaska move, compare supported communities using neutral criteria, estimate broad mortgage closing-cost and VA funding-fee ranges, prepare an authorized external property search, and create a privacy-preserving handoff to Nieves de Alaska without collecting contact information inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Nieves Alaska Relocation 帮助用户规划搬迁至阿拉斯加，按照中立标准比较受支持的社区，估算大致的抵押贷款成交成本和 VA 资金费范围，准备获授权的外部房产搜索，并以保护隐私的方式转交给 Nieves de Alaska，过程中不会在 ChatGPT 内收集联系信息。

payload.name: Roovook

payload.name: Transferhood
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book reliable private airport transfers worldwide with Transferhood. Find and manage airport transportation, view transfer details, and enjoy a seamless travel experience from booking to arrival.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Transferhood 预订全球可靠的私人机场接送服务。查找并管理机场交通，查看接送详情，享受从预订到抵达的顺畅出行体验。

payload.name: eSIMradar
payload.description: 比较旅行 eSIM 套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
eSIMradar compares prepaid travel eSIM data plans from 60+ providers across 210+ destinations, so a traveller can see what mobile data actually costs where they are going.

Ask for a destination and it returns a ranked shortlist with the data allowance, validity, total price in USD and price per gigabyte, alongside the true size of the catalogue it drew from. Narrow by data need, trip length, budget, or features like 5G, hotspot sharing and top-up. Ask about one plan and it returns the detail that decides a purchase: fair-use throttling, whether the allowance is per day, the activation model, whether identity verification is required, which carriers it roams on, and which other countries it covers. Ask about a provider and it returns coverage, catalogue size, reader reviews and how much of that provider we have verified.

Results are ranked over the whole catalogue for a destination rather than a promoted subset, and no provider is allowed to occupy the shortlist. Prices are rebuilt from provider catalogues continuously.

eSIMradar earns affiliate commission when a reader buys through the site. That relationship decides which plans the website puts forward on one of its tabs; it never orders the results these tools return. Every plan links to its page on esimradar.com, where the reader compares and completes any purchase.
payload.longDescription:
eSIMradar 比较来自 60 多家供应商、覆盖 210 多个目的地的预付费旅行 eSIM 流量套餐，让旅客了解目的地移动数据的实际价格。

告诉它目的地，它会从完整目录中给出排名靠前的候选套餐，包括流量额度、有效期、美元总价和每 GB 价格，并说明目录的实际规模。你可按流量需求、旅行时长、预算或 5G、热点共享、充值等功能缩小范围。询问某个套餐时，它会提供影响购买决策的详情：公平使用政策下的限速、流量额度是否按天计算、激活方式、是否需要身份验证、漫游合作运营商及套餐覆盖的其他国家/地区。询问某家供应商时，它会提供覆盖范围、目录规模、读者评价以及已核实信息的比例。

结果依据目的地的完整目录排名，不会让任何一家供应商占据候选名单。价格会持续根据供应商目录重新计算。

eSIMradar 会在读者通过网站购买时获得联盟营销佣金。这种合作关系会影响网站某个标签页推荐哪些套餐，但不会影响这些工具返回结果的排序。每个套餐都链接到 esimradar.com 上的对应页面，读者可在那里比较并完成购买。

payload.name: Ivon
payload.description: 租赁海滩、婴幼儿和户外派对用品
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ivon is the peer-to-peer marketplace that lets you rent:

- Baby & toddler gear – strollers, cribs, car seats, high chairs, and more
- Beach essentials – chairs, umbrellas, coolers, and beach toys
- Water sports – kayaks, paddleboards, and related gear
- Bikes, scooters, and other outdoor equipment
payload.longDescription:
Ivon 是点对点租赁市场，可租用：

- 婴幼儿用品：婴儿车、婴儿床、汽车座椅、高脚椅等
- 海滩用品：椅子、遮阳伞、冷藏箱和沙滩玩具
- 水上运动用品：皮划艇、桨板及相关装备
- 自行车、滑板车和其他户外设备

payload.name: Instafan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instafan helps groups decide where to go — together. Ask for a mood and get real destination suggestions, pull a live brief on any city (weather this month, official safety verdict), see its strongest Google-rated places with real photos right in the chat, and get a day-by-day plan built from them. Nothing is invented: every place is a real, rated spot. One link carries the trip into instafan.app, where your whole group can immerse in 3D, save spots, and vote.
payload.longDescription: Instafan 帮助团体共同决定去哪里。告诉它你们喜欢的氛围，即可获取真实目的地建议；查看任何城市的实时概况（本月天气、官方安全结论）；在聊天中查看 Google 评分较高的地点及真实照片；并据此生成逐日行程。所有信息都不是编造的：每个地点都是真实且有评分的场所。一个链接即可将行程带到 instafan.app，让整个团队通过 3D 方式探索、收藏地点并投票。

payload.name: SplashScout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SplashScout finds family water-holiday hotels and campsites and scores each one for the ages travelling — toddlers, kids and teens — based on pools, slides, splash zones, kids' clubs and guest reviews. It returns interactive cards with per-age scores, water features, guest ratings and booking links.
payload.longDescription: SplashScout 帮你寻找适合家庭水上度假的酒店和露营地，并根据同行者的年龄——幼儿、儿童和青少年——对每个地点评分，依据包括泳池、滑梯、戏水区、儿童俱乐部和住客评价。它会返回交互式卡片，展示各年龄段评分、水上设施、住客评分和预订链接。

payload.name: One Step Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan trips with personalized itineraries and estimated travel costs. One Step Travel can estimate the cost of a trip to a specific destination, create day-by-day trip plans, and suggest U.S. destinations that fit a traveler's budget.
payload.longDescription: 使用个性化行程和预估旅行费用来规划旅程。One Step Travel 可以估算前往特定目的地的旅行成本、制定逐日旅行计划，并推荐符合旅客预算的美国目的地。

payload.name: eSIM-Global.VIP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: eSIM-Global.VIP provides prepaid mobile-data eSIMs for international travel. The MCP server lets ChatGPT find and compare live eSIM plans, get full plan details, recommend plans for a trip, answer shop and device questions, and hand the customer to the eSIM-Global.VIP website for secure checkout. The server is read-only: it does not create orders or provide in-chat order tracking.
payload.longDescription: eSIM-Global.VIP为国际旅行提供预付费移动数据eSIM。MCP服务器让ChatGPT能够查找并比较实时eSIM计划，获取完整计划详情，为行程推荐合适方案，解答店铺和设备相关问题，并将客户引导至eSIM-Global.VIP网站完成安全结账。该服务器为只读模式：无法创建订单或提供聊天内的订单追踪服务。

payload.name: trip1
payload.description: 预订酒店并使用加密货币付款
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: trip1 lets agents search, compare and book real hotel inventory — roughly 3 million properties in 200+ countries. Search by destination and dates, inspect rooms, rates and cancellation terms, then create a reservation and pay in USDC on Base over x402 (or via a browser-based crypto checkout). Bookings confirm automatically once payment settles.
payload.longDescription: trip1 可让智能体搜索、比较并预订真实酒店库存——约 3 million 家酒店，遍布 200+ 个国家/地区。按目的地和日期搜索，查看客房、价格和取消条款，然后创建预订，并通过 x402 使用 Base 上的 USDC 付款（或通过基于浏览器的加密货币结账）。付款结算后，预订会自动确认。

payload.name: Condor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your next trip with Condor directly in ChatGPT. Get inspired by destinations around the world, explore the travel options that best suit your plans across different routes, months, and seasons, and compare suitable one-way or round-trip flights for your travel party. Discover flight times, cabin classes, fare options, and included services – and start looking forward to your next adventure.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中通过 Condor 规划下一趟旅行。从世界各地的目的地获取灵感，探索不同航线、月份和季节中最适合你计划的旅行选项，并为同行旅客比较合适的单程或往返航班。了解航班时间、客舱等级、票价选项和包含的服务，开始期待下一次冒险。

payload.name: Flyin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
As one of the largest travel platforms in Saudi Arabia and the nearby regions, Flyin is trusted by more than one million customers for seamless air ticket booking and travel experiences.

With a solid track record of 15+ years, we have helped our travellers find great deals, with offerings like flexible fares for families, tailor-made itineraries, and convenient fly-now-pay-later options.

From over 450 airline options to an extensive hotel network to convenient direct flights and diverse travel packages, planning your journey is refreshingly simple.

With value-added services like EzCancel, FlexiFly, travel insurance, and smart delay protection, Flyin gives our customers the level of reassurance booking with flights and hotels that few platforms offer.
payload.longDescription:
Flyin 是沙特阿拉伯及周边地区规模最大的旅行平台之一，受到超过 100 万客户信赖，为用户提供便捷的机票预订和旅行体验。

凭借超过 15 年的丰富经验，我们帮助旅客找到超值优惠，提供适合家庭的灵活票价、量身定制的行程，以及便捷的先飞后付选项。

平台提供 450 多家航空公司的选择、庞大的酒店网络、便捷的直飞航班和丰富的旅行套餐，让行程规划变得轻松简单。

Flyin 还提供 EzCancel、FlexiFly、旅行保险和智能延误保障等增值服务，为机票和酒店预订带来其他少数平台才能提供的安心保障。

payload.name: BonjourRATP
payload.description: 规划你的法兰西岛出行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bonjour RATP vous aide à trouver le meilleur itinéraire en transports en commun en Île‑de‑France, rien que pour vous.

L’application calcule des trajets multimodaux en combinant l’ensemble des réseaux : métro, RER, Transilien, bus et tramway. Chaque proposition tient compte de l’information trafic en temps réel, des perturbations et des travaux en cours afin de vous proposer des trajets fiables et adaptés.

Que vous prépariez un déplacement ou que vous cherchiez le meilleur chemin pour partir maintenant, Bonjour RATP vous permet de comparer les options disponibles et de choisir l’itinéraire le plus pertinent pour votre trajet.
payload.longDescription:
Bonjour RATP帮助你在法兰西岛找到专门适合你的最佳公共交通路线。

应用结合所有交通网络计算多模式路线：地铁、RER、Transilien、巴士和有轨电车。每个方案都会考虑实时交通信息、运行中断和正在进行的施工，以提供可靠且适合的路线。

无论你是在提前规划出行，还是想找到现在出发的最佳路径，Bonjour RATP都能让你比较可用选项，为行程选择最合适的路线。

payload.name: Princess Cruises
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask anything in plain English and get instant answers pulled directly from Princess.com —destinations, itineraries, sail dates, and pricing. Explore the full Princess catalog without switching tabs, then go straight to booking when you're ready.

What you can do:
• Search by destination, date, duration, or departure port
• Discover itineraries and ports matched to your interests
• Jump directly to Princess.com to book

Try asking:
1. Which Mediterranean itineraries sail in May?
2. What Caribbean ports does Princess visit in winter?
3. Show me Alaska cruises from Seattle
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言提出任何问题，即可直接从 Princess.com 获取有关目的地、行程、航行日期和价格的即时答复。无需切换标签页即可浏览完整的 Princess 目录，准备好后可直接前往预订。

你可以：
• 按目的地、日期、时长或出发港口搜索
• 发现符合你兴趣的行程和停靠港
• 直接前往 Princess.com 预订

试着问：
1. 五月有哪些地中海航线？
2. Princess 冬季会停靠哪些加勒比海港口？
3. 显示从西雅图出发的阿拉斯加邮轮

payload.name: Besty AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Besty AI searches real inventory from professional vacation rental managers, shows day-by-day rate calendars and reviews, produces live quotes with full fee and tax breakdowns, and hands you a checkout link on the property manager's own website with your dates and guests pre-filled. Booking direct means no online-travel-agency markup. Prices come straight from each property's management system: cached calendars say exactly when they were refreshed, and final totals are always quoted live.
payload.longDescription: Besty AI 搜索专业度假租赁管理公司的真实房源，展示逐日价格日历和评价，生成包含完整费用与税费明细的实时报价，并提供房产管理公司自有网站的结账链接，预先填写你的日期和入住人数。直接预订意味着没有在线旅行社加价。价格直接来自每处房产的管理系统：缓存日历明确标注刷新时间，最终总价始终实时报出。

payload.name: HopeGoo
payload.description: 通过 HopeGoo 查找酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Official HopeGoo hotel finder. Describe your travel needs in natural language and get recommended hotels with prices, ratings, and direct links to HopeGoo detail pages.
payload.longDescription: HopeGoo 官方酒店搜索工具。用自然语言描述旅行需求，即可获取推荐酒店、价格、评分及指向 HopeGoo 详情页的直达链接。

payload.name: TripCanvas
payload.description: AI 旅行顾问和行程规划工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TripCanvas is an AI travel agent, trip planner, and travel itinerary builder inside ChatGPT. It turns your dates, destination, interests, constraints, preferred pace, and travel companions into a complete public trip website: a geographically coherent route, day-by-day itinerary, overnight bases, driving distances, road names, maps, places to see, and priority bookings in one shareable link for the whole group. Users connect a TripCanvas account through OAuth; one new website is included per UTC month, while reopening and sharing do not consume another allowance unit. When no allowance remains, the plugin shows the reset date and links only to an informational account-and-allowance page. It never displays prices or initiates a purchase inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: TripCanvas 是集 AI 旅行顾问、旅行规划和行程创建于一体的 ChatGPT 工具。它会根据日期、目的地、兴趣、限制条件、偏好节奏和同行旅伴，生成完整的公开旅行网站：包括地理路线合理的路线图、逐日行程、过夜住宿地点、行车距离、道路名称、地图、游览地点，以及供整个团队通过一个链接分享的优先预订事项。用户通过 OAuth 连接 TripCanvas 账户；每个 UTC 月可创建 1 个新网站，重新打开和分享不会额外消耗额度。额度用完后，插件会显示重置日期，并且只链接到介绍账户和额度信息的页面。它不会在 ChatGPT 中显示价格或发起购买。

payload.name: K-Beauty, Spa & Hair Booking
payload.description: 在韩国预订 K-Beauty 服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover and book beauty and wellness services across Korea with TIMEPLEX. 
Find spas, massage shops, hair salons, skincare and facial studios, nail salons, and scalp treatments in Seoul, Busan, Jeju, and other destinations. Compare services, prices, locations, available times, and language support for international visitors.
payload.longDescription:
通过 TIMEPLEX 探索并预订韩国各地的美容和健康服务。
在首尔、釜山、济州及其他目的地查找水疗中心、按摩店、美发沙龙、护肤和面部护理工作室、美甲沙龙及头皮护理服务。比较服务项目、价格、地点、可预约时间，以及面向国际访客的语言支持。

payload.name: Stayonomy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Stayonomy answers travel questions with real, bookable prices instead of estimates. It compares every way to get between two cities - flight, train, bus and ferry - with durations and current cached fares in EUR; finds the cheapest days and months to fly; lists hotels with nightly rates; and covers the rest of the trip too: car rental at the destination, prepaid travel eSIM plans with catalog prices for 200+ destinations, tours and tickets, city guides, and month-by-month climate advice.

Fares are real prices travellers found recently, refreshed daily and served from Stayonomy's own database - every answer says how fresh the data is, and the booking site confirms the final price. All tools are read-only; the app needs no account and collects no personal data. Booking links may contain affiliate identifiers, which is how Stayonomy is funded; this never affects the prices shown.

Operated by Starcode Services Kft. (Budapest, Hungary).
payload.longDescription:
Stayonomy 用真实、可预订的价格（而非估算值）回答旅行问题。它会比较两个城市之间的所有交通方式——飞机、火车、巴士和渡轮——提供行程时长和当前缓存的 EUR 票价；找出乘飞机出行最便宜的日期和月份；列出含每晚价格的酒店；还涵盖旅程的其他需求：目的地租车、适用于 200+ 个目的地且附目录价格的预付费旅行 eSIM 套餐、旅游和门票、城市指南，以及逐月气候建议。

票价是旅行者近期找到的真实价格，每天刷新并来自 Stayonomy 自有数据库——每个答案都会注明数据的新鲜程度，预订网站会确认最终价格。所有工具均为只读；此应用无需账户，也不收集个人数据。预订链接可能包含联盟标识符，这是 Stayonomy 的资金来源；但这绝不会影响所显示的价格。

运营方：Starcode Services Kft.（Budapest, Hungary）。

payload.name: Piazza in Festa
payload.description: 意大利城镇活动与集市
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Piazza in Festa answers questions about what is happening in Italian towns: village feasts, patron saint festivals, food and wine fairs, street markets, concerts and exhibitions. The catalogue is rebuilt every day from the notices that town halls are legally required to publish on their official register, so it also covers very small towns that no other calendar lists. Users can search by town, region, category, free text or date range, open a single event for practical details such as dates, venue and organiser, and ask which towns are covered in a region. Every result carries a link to the event page and to the official document it was derived from, so answers can be verified.
payload.longDescription: Piazza in Festa 回答意大利城镇正在发生的活动，包括乡村节庆、主保圣人节、食品和葡萄酒集市、街市、音乐会和展览。目录每天根据市政厅依法发布的官方登记公告重建，因此也覆盖其他日历不会列出的小城镇。用户可以按城镇、地区、类别、自由文本或日期范围搜索，打开单个活动查看日期、地点和主办方等实用详情，并询问某个地区覆盖哪些城镇。每个结果都带有活动页面链接和据此生成的官方文件链接，方便核验。

payload.name: Pearl
payload.description: 借助 Pearl 个人资料规划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pearl helps eligible Access members search and match trusted places, discover new and upcoming openings, get personalized recommendations, review their private Pearl profile and travel activity, check restaurant table availability without booking, and preview then confirm visit logging or edits in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Pearl 帮助符合条件的 Access 会员搜索并匹配值得信赖的地点、发现新开业和即将开业的场所、获取个性化推荐、查看私人 Pearl 个人资料和旅行活动、查询餐厅桌位情况（不进行预订），并在 ChatGPT 中预览后确认记录或编辑到访信息。

payload.name: Forktime
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Forktime books tables at restaurants that use Forktime for reservations.

Name a venue or search Forktime restaurants by area and cuisine, check real
availability for your date, time and party size, and confirm a booking right
in the conversation.

Availability comes from each restaurant's live reservation system, so the
times shown are times you can actually book.

After booking, you'll get a text with a link to manage your reservation.

Forktime venues are in Australia, the United States and Canada.
payload.longDescription:
Forktime 可在使用 Forktime 进行预订的餐厅订位。

说出餐厅名称，或按地区和菜系搜索 Forktime 餐厅；查询指定日期、时间和人数的实时空位，并直接在对话中确认预订。

空位信息来自各餐厅的实时预订系统，因此显示的时段都可以实际预订。

预订后，你会收到一条短信，其中包含管理预订的链接。

Forktime 合作餐厅位于澳大利亚、美国和加拿大。

payload.name: Flaut.Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find better flights and decide where to go with data-driven travel insights. Search airfare for specific dates, explore year-round price trends, compare departure and arrival airports, see direct-flight availability and operating airlines, and discover destinations based on your preferred climate, continent, and budget.
payload.longDescription: 利用数据洞察寻找更合适的航班，并决定去哪里旅行。搜索特定日期的机票，查看全年价格趋势，比较出发和到达机场，查询直飞航班及运营航空公司，并根据偏好的气候、大洲和预算发现目的地。

payload.name: Holiday Autos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Here at Holiday Autos we make car hire easy. Wherever you’re going, we find you the best car at the best possible price. Get great car hire across 50,000+ pickup locations worldwide.
payload.longDescription: Holiday Autos 让租车变得简单。无论你要去哪里，我们都会帮你找到最合适、价格尽可能优惠的车辆。全球超过 50,000+ 个取车地点均可租车。

payload.name: Tineo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tineo helps you organize travel plans through ChatGPT. Connect your Tineo account to find your trips, view itinerary details, and keep flights, stays, transport, and activities together.

Create a trip, add itinerary items, and update saved travel details in conversation. Look up places and check the available flight information for saved flight segments. Your itinerary stays in your Tineo account so you can return to it later.

A Tineo account is required. Editing a saved itinerary changes your Tineo records; it does not change a reservation with an airline, hotel, or other travel provider.
payload.longDescription:
Tineo 帮助你通过 ChatGPT 整理旅行计划。连接 Tineo 账户即可查找行程、查看行程详情，并将航班、住宿、交通和活动集中管理。

创建旅行、添加行程项目，并在对话中更新已保存的旅行详情。查找地点并查看已保存航班航段的可用航班信息。行程保存在你的 Tineo 账户中，方便日后继续查看。

需要 Tineo 账户。编辑已保存的行程只会更改你的 Tineo 记录，不会更改你在航空公司、酒店或其他旅行服务商处的预订。

payload.name: BirdWatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore published birdwatching tours from the BirdWatch catalogue. Search by destination, target birds, tour style, duration, dates and budget; read available itineraries and tour details; and follow BirdWatch links to make an inquiry. Prices, availability and wildlife sightings require confirmation. BirdWatch does not book trips or send inquiries through this integration.
payload.longDescription: 探索 BirdWatch 目录中已发布的观鸟旅行团。按目的地、目标鸟类、旅行风格、时长、日期和预算搜索；阅读可用的行程安排和旅行团详情；通过 BirdWatch 链接提出咨询。价格、可用名额和野生动物目击情况需要确认。BirdWatch 不通过此集成预订旅行或发送咨询。

payload.name: Baraglo Travel Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compara planes, precios y coberturas de seguros de viaje internacionales con Baraglo. Obtén cotizaciones personalizadas según el destino, las fechas de viaje, la edad de los viajeros y el país de residencia. Revisa los beneficios disponibles y los requisitos de viaje para destinos como Estados Unidos, Europa, el espacio Schengen, Canadá y Latinoamérica. Asistencia disponible las 24 horas, todos los días.
payload.longDescription: 通过Baraglo比较国际旅行保险的方案、价格和保障范围。根据目的地、旅行日期、旅客年龄和居住国家获取个性化报价。查看前往美国、欧洲、申根区、加拿大和拉丁美洲等目的地时可用的保障权益和旅行要求。每天24小时提供援助。

payload.name: Metro MCP
payload.description: 实时查询华盛顿特区和纽约市交通
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Metro MCP provides free, live, read-only public transit information for Washington, DC and New York City. Check train arrivals, search stations, inspect service incidents and elevator outages, view bus and train positions, and look up NYC route details. The interactive Transit Board keeps results easy to scan, with text and structured fallbacks for other clients. No Metro MCP login, credentials, or purchase is required.
payload.longDescription: Metro MCP 免费提供华盛顿特区和纽约市的实时公共交通信息，且仅提供只读访问。你可以查看列车到站时间、搜索车站、查看服务故障和电梯停运情况、查看公交车和列车位置，以及查询纽约市路线详情。交互式 Transit Board 让结果一目了然，并为其他客户端提供文本和结构化备用输出。使用 Metro MCP 无需登录、凭据或购买。

payload.name: ReturnOS Hospitality Commerce
payload.description: 查找住宿和实时直订价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search direct-bookable accommodation, check live availability and current direct prices, and continue to the host’s direct booking path. Live results come from ReturnOS inventory and pricing. Booking and payment remain guest-controlled.
payload.longDescription:
该插件查找住宿和实时直订价格。以下功能和限制适用：
Search direct-bookable accommodation, check live availability and current direct prices, and continue to the host’s direct booking path. Live results come from ReturnOS inventory and pricing. Booking and payment remain guest-controlled.

payload.name: Wave by Vento
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wave by Vento helps attendees explore confirmed Wave 2026 sessions and speakers, browse a visual agenda and live side events, and find source-grounded answers about travel, passes, venue access, policies, and attendee support.
payload.longDescription: Wave by Vento 帮助参会者浏览已确认的 Wave 2026 议程和演讲者，查看可视化日程和现场周边活动，并查找有关交通、通行证、场馆出入、政策和参会者支持的、以来源为依据的答案。

payload.name: Secret World — Hidden Gems
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Secret World — Hidden Gems gives ChatGPT direct access to a curated catalog of 340,000+ lesser-known places and 750,000+ original photos worldwide.

Ask for hidden gems near any city, less touristy alternatives to famous landmarks ("I've seen the Colosseum — what am I missing nearby?"), or unusual places worth a small detour on a road trip. Every result is a real place with verified coordinates, an original photo and a source page on Secret World (sworld.co.uk).

The app is read-only and requires no account: it never asks for, stores or processes any personal data. Famous landmarks are filtered out by design — this app is only about the places most visitors miss.
payload.longDescription:
Secret World — Hidden Gems 让 ChatGPT 直接访问一个精选目录，其中包含全球 340,000+ 个鲜为人知的地点和 750,000+ 张原创照片。

询问任意城市附近的隐藏宝藏、著名地标周边不那么热门的替代去处（“我看过罗马斗兽场了——附近还有什么值得看？”），或公路旅行中值得稍作绕行的特别地点。每条结果都是真实地点，附有经过核实的坐标、原创照片和 Secret World (sworld.co.uk) 上的来源页面。

该应用为只读且无需账户：绝不会请求、存储或处理任何个人数据。著名地标按设计会被过滤掉——此应用只关注大多数游客会错过的地点。

payload.name: PlanYourTrip
payload.description: 往返多城市旅行规划器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan multi-city round trips from real-world travel data. Discover the most-visited cities in a country or region, build a route stop by stop, and open the finished trip on an interactive map in the Plan Your Trip planner — where you can adjust stops and nights and get cost and hotel estimates. No account needed.
payload.longDescription: 根据真实世界的旅行数据规划多城市往返行程。发现一个国家或地区游客最多的城市，逐站构建路线，并在 Plan Your Trip 规划器的交互式地图上打开最终行程——您可以在其中调整停留城市和住宿晚数，并获取费用和酒店估算。无需账户。

payload.name: AHORN Hotels & Resorts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the world of AHORN Hotels & Resorts right in your app. Find the perfect hotel, book your next vacation conveniently online, and take advantage of exclusive offers, the latest information, and practical services for your stay. Whether it’s a family holiday, an active getaway, a relaxing break, or a short trip—the AHORN app accompanies you from the initial inspiration to your arrival.
payload.longDescription: 直接在应用中探索 AHORN Hotels & Resorts 的世界。寻找理想酒店，便捷地在线预订下一次假期，并享受专属优惠、最新信息和入住实用服务。无论是家庭度假、活力之旅、放松休息还是短途旅行，AHORN 应用都会从最初的灵感到抵达目的地一路陪伴。

payload.name: CatamaranSite
payload.description: 查看正在出售的双体船
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CatamaranSite lists catamarans for sale worldwide — sailing and power, from
international brokerages and from private owners selling their own boat.

Ask for what you actually want and the connector searches the live catalogue:
builder, model, asking price, length, year, number of cabins, cruising area, and
sail or power. Results come back as cards you can look through without leaving the
conversation — photographs, asking price, length, cabins and where the boat is
lying. Tap one and the full listing opens in place, with the description, the
specification and whether you are dealing with a broker or the owner.

You can also put two to four boats side by side on the specifications that
actually decide between them, or ask which builders currently have boats for sale
before you have narrowed anything down.

Everything is read-only and nothing is submitted on your behalf. When you want to
enquire, the connector links you to the listing on catamaransite.com, where the
seller's own contact form is.

Only boats currently for sale are searchable. Sold and withdrawn listings are
excluded, as are their prices.
payload.longDescription:
CatamaranSite 汇集全球在售的双体船——帆船和动力船，来自国际经纪公司，也包括出售自有船只的私人船主。

告诉连接器你真正想找的船，它便会搜索实时目录：制造商、型号、要价、船长、年份、舱室数量、航行区域，以及帆船或动力船。结果以卡片形式显示，你无需离开对话即可浏览照片、要价、船长、舱室数量和船只所在位置。点击某条信息即可在当前页面打开完整列表，包括描述、规格，以及交易对象是经纪人还是船主。

你还可以按真正影响选择的规格并排比较 2 到 4 艘船，或者在尚未缩小范围前询问目前哪些制造商有船在售。

所有操作均为只读，不会代你提交任何内容。想要咨询时，连接器会将你链接到 catamaransite.com 上的船只列表，那里提供卖家自己的联系表单。

只能搜索当前在售的船只。已售出和已撤下的信息及其价格均不包含在内。

payload.name: Futrumi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, and the exact dish or drink they recommend. This plugin brings that curated, published data into ChatGPT, so you can ask where to eat in Vinohrady tonight, or what Michal Danek recommends, and get real expert opinions instead of aggregated review scores.

Every result carries the expert's name, their quote in the original Czech, the venue with address and opening hours, and a link to open it in the Futrumi app. Coverage spans restaurants, cafes, bars, bakeries and wine shops, primarily in Prague and Brno.

Data covers Czechia only. A question about Vienna or Bratislava returns an explicit "no recommendations found" rather than a guess. Quotes stay in the original Czech so the expert's wording is preserved, and ChatGPT can translate them on request. Everything served is already published in the Futrumi app, with no private or pre-publication content. The plugin is read-only and anonymous: no account, no API key.
payload.longDescription:
Futrumi 是一个捷克美食推荐平台：知名美食评论家、厨师、侍酒师和美食记者会分享自己真正喜欢的餐饮场所，以及他们推荐的具体菜品或饮品。此插件将经过策选并已发布的数据带入 ChatGPT，你可以询问今晚在 Vinohrady 去哪里吃饭，或 Michal Danek 推荐什么，从而获得真实专家意见，而不是汇总评分。

每条结果都包含专家姓名、捷克语原文引述、场所地址和营业时间，以及在 Futrumi 应用中打开的链接。覆盖餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧、面包店和葡萄酒商店，主要集中在布拉格和布尔诺。

数据仅涵盖捷克。询问维也纳或布拉迪斯拉发时，系统会明确回复“未找到推荐”，不会猜测。引述保留捷克语原文，以保持专家的原意；你可以要求 ChatGPT 翻译。提供的所有内容都已在 Futrumi 应用中发布，不含私人或尚未发布的内容。该插件为只读且匿名使用：无需账户或 API 密钥。

payload.name: BookYolo
payload.description: 为下一次住宿做合理性检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface fatal flaws,  hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss. BookYolo goes beyond ratings and surface level reviews by running a deep analysis of each property through a 100-point inspection.

Many properties appear highly rated online, yet travelers still run into unexpected issues on arrival. Reviews are often influenced by politeness bias, where guests soften criticism or focus on positives. At the same time, unhappy guests do not always leave reviews at all, which further skews the overall picture. Add to that the sheer volume of reviews, often hundreds per listing, and it becomes unrealistic for travelers to read and interpret everything themselves.
payload.longDescription:
BookYolo 是一款 AI 驱动的旅行工具，旨在帮助你在预订前检查酒店和度假租赁住宿的品质。该平台分析公开的房源信息和住客反馈，揭示旅行者经常遗漏的致命缺陷、隐藏的危险信号、评价模式、过度宣传与营销手法、意外费用和预期落差。BookYolo 不止关注评分和表面评价，而是通过 100 项检查对每处住宿进行深入分析。

许多住宿在网上评分很高，但旅行者抵达后仍会遇到意想不到的问题。评价常受到礼貌偏差的影响，住客会弱化批评或着重描述优点。同时，不满意的住客并不总会留下评价，这进一步扭曲了整体情况。再加上每条房源往往有数百条评价，旅行者自行阅读和理解全部内容已不现实。

payload.name: Car Shipping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Car Shipping helps users plan vehicle transport, compare ballpark auto transport estimates, understand options like open versus enclosed transport, and connect with transport providers for firm quotes. Estimates are clearly labeled as planning numbers, and provider links disclose when they may be commissioned affiliate links.
payload.longDescription: Car Shipping 帮助用户规划车辆运输、比较大致的汽车运输估价、了解开放式与封闭式运输等选项，并联系运输服务商获取正式报价。估价会明确标注为规划参考数字，服务商链接也会说明是否可能属于付费联盟链接。

payload.name: Vacanța România
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vacanța România helps you discover verified tourist attractions across Romania: natural sites, castles and fortresses, monasteries and churches, museums, and hiking areas. Ask what to visit in a county or town, what is near you within a chosen radius, or explore by theme — nature, history, culture, lesser-known places. Every result comes with a short description in Romanian or English, the county and locality, coordinates, and a link to the full page on vacantaromania.ro (holidayinromania.com in English), so you can read more, see photos and plan the trip. The data is a curated database of published attractions, kept up to date by the Vacanța România team. No account is needed and nothing about you is stored.
payload.longDescription: Vacanța România 帮助你探索罗马尼亚各地经过核实的旅游景点：自然景观、城堡和要塞、修道院和教堂、博物馆及徒步区域。你可以询问某个县或城镇有哪些景点、所选半径范围内附近有什么，也可以按主题探索——自然、历史、文化或鲜为人知的地方。每条结果都附有罗马尼亚语或英语的简短介绍、所在县和地点、坐标，以及指向 vacantaromania.ro（英文版为 holidayinromania.com）完整页面的链接，方便你了解详情、查看照片并规划行程。数据来自精心整理的已发布景点数据库，并由 Vacanța România 团队持续更新。无需账户，也不会存储任何关于你的信息。

payload.name: Provue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Provue helps users compare available flight fares, travel options, diagnostic tests, health packages, and home sample-collection availability before deciding what to book or buy.
payload.longDescription: Provue 可帮助用户比较可选航班票价、旅行方案、诊断检测、健康套餐和上门采样服务，然后再决定预订或购买。

payload.name: Motion4rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Motion4rent lets you find and compare mobility equipment rentals — manual and electric wheelchairs, mobility scooters, knee walkers, rollators and similar mobility aids — in thousands of cities worldwide, through a network of trusted local partners. It covers mobility aids only: not bicycles, e-bikes, motorbikes or cars.

Tell the assistant your city and travel dates and it finds available equipment with the FINAL price (taxes and management fee already included — no surprises), product photos, key specs (max weight, range, folding, type) and the delivery options that actually apply: store pickup, delivery to your home, hotel or apartment, airport, or cruise port. Prices can be shown in the currency you choose, and free-cancellation and deposit terms are shown up front.

When you're ready to book, it links you to the Motion4rent website, where you complete the reservation and payment securely. The app itself never takes a booking, never charges you and never asks for personal or payment details.

Ideal for travelers with reduced mobility, people recovering from surgery, families arranging equipment for an elderly relative, or anyone who needs mobility gear at their destination without carrying their own.

Operated by Motion4rent (TimetoMobility S.L.).
payload.longDescription:
Motion4rent 通过可信的本地合作伙伴网络，让你在全球数千个城市查找并比较出行设备租赁，包括手动和电动轮椅、代步车、膝行车、助行器及类似辅助设备。仅覆盖出行辅助设备，不包括自行车、电动自行车、摩托车或汽车。

告诉助手城市和旅行日期，它会查找可用设备，并显示最终价格（已含税费和管理费，无隐藏费用）、产品照片、关键规格（最大承重、续航、可折叠性、类型）以及实际适用的交付方式：门店取货、送至住宅、酒店或公寓、机场或邮轮港。价格可按所选货币显示，免费取消和押金条款会提前展示。
准备预订时，应用会链接到

Motion4rent 网站，在那里安全完成预订和付款。应用本身从不接受预订、不向你收费，也不索取个人或付款信息。
适合行动不便的旅行者、术后康复者、为年长亲属安排设备的家庭，或任何希望在目的地使用而无需携带自有设备的人。

由 Motion4rent（TimetoMobility

S.L.）运营。

payload.name: Coliving
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coliving.com helps people discover monthly coliving spaces around the world. Search published listings by destination, price, room type, amenities, and community; explore room and property details; check availability and guest reviews; and compare options. The app can also answer questions using public Coliving.com help articles. Viewing personal booking details requires signing in.
payload.longDescription: Coliving.com 帮助人们在世界各地寻找按月出租的合住空间。按目的地、价格、房间类型、配套设施和社区搜索已发布房源；浏览房间和房产详情；查看空房情况及住客评价；并比较不同选项。该应用还可以根据 Coliving.com 的公开帮助文章回答问题。查看个人预订详情需要登录。

payload.name: Westbahn
payload.description: 查找并预订 Westbahn 列车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Westbahn connections between Vienna, St. Pölten, Linz, Salzburg, Innsbruck, Munich and Stuttgart and see what the journey actually costs before you leave the chat.
Say where and when you want to travel and who is coming along — adults, children and you get the matching departures with fares for your whole group. Each connection shows the available fare types and comfort classes (Standard, Comfort, First) with current prices and availability, so you can weigh an early train at a saver fare against a flexible ticket later in the day.
Once you've picked a train, the plugin hands you over to westbahn.at with route, date, passengers and class already filled in. You confirm the selection and pay directly with Westbahn.
Timetables, fares and availability come straight from Westbahn, the operator of the trains.
payload.longDescription:
搜索 Westbahn 在维也纳、St. Pölten、林茨、萨尔茨堡、因斯布鲁克、慕尼黑和斯图加特之间的线路，并在离开聊天前了解实际票价。
告诉我们你的出行地点和时间，以及同行人员（成人、儿童），即可查看适合全体同行者的发车班次和票价。每趟车都会显示可选票种和舒适等级（Standard、Comfort、First），以及当前价格和余票情况，方便你权衡较早的优惠票与当天晚些时候的灵活车票。
选定列车后，插件会将你带到 westbahn.at，并预先填写路线、日期、乘客和等级。你确认选择后，直接向 Westbahn 付款。
时刻表、票价和余票情况均直接来自列车运营商 Westbahn。

payload.name: WonderKit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WonderKit helps friends, couples and families plan trips together. Ask what to do in a city and WonderKit returns curated, venue-verified things to do for families, couples or friends, plus researched day-by-day itineraries and themed place guides, including seasonal trips such as fall foliage road trips in New England, the Hudson Valley and Shenandoah. Every result links to the full guide on wonderkit.app, and you can hand off to the WonderKit planner to build a custom trip with your group. The app is read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes anything, needs no account, and cannot see anyone's private trips.
payload.longDescription: WonderKit 帮助朋友、伴侣和家庭一起规划旅行。询问某座城市有哪些活动，WonderKit 就会提供经过场所核实、适合家庭、情侣或朋友的精选活动，以及经过调研的逐日行程和主题地点指南，其中包括新英格兰、哈德逊河谷和谢南多厄等地的秋叶自驾游。每条结果都链接到 wonderkit.app 上的完整指南，你还可以转到 WonderKit planner，与同行者一起制定定制行程。该应用为只读：不会创建、修改或删除任何内容，无需账号，也无法查看任何人的私人行程。

payload.name: Sonar Connections
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sonar Connections gives ChatGPT structured, source-attributed records, and every reply names its source.

Events: events published through Sonar Connections, with floor plans, booths and vendors, agenda and speakers, and live offers. The floor can open as an interactive card. Source: the event organizer, credited on each reply.

Public open data: dataset catalogs and records from public open data portals, with each dataset's license. Source: the portal operator, for example the City of Long Beach open data portal (DataLB).

The tools read data; one diagnostics tool lets the interactive cards report load and layout counts. No sign-in is required. When a record is not served, the reply says so and lists what is served.
payload.longDescription:
Sonar Connections 为 ChatGPT 提供结构化且注明来源的记录，每条回复都会标明来源。

活动：通过 Sonar Connections 发布的活动信息，包括平面图、展位和供应商、日程和演讲者，以及实时优惠。展馆可作为交互式卡片打开。来源：活动主办方，并会在每条回复中注明。

公共开放数据：来自公共开放数据门户的数据集目录和记录，并附有每个数据集的许可信息。来源：门户运营方，例如 City of Long Beach open data portal (DataLB)。

这些工具只读取数据；其中一个诊断工具可让交互式卡片报告加载和布局数量。无需登录。如果某条记录未提供，回复会说明这一点，并列出实际提供的内容。

payload.name: Slashtel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find a travel eSIM for your trip or top up a prepaid phone abroad, right from ChatGPT. Slashtel shows live data plans for 190+ destinations with price, data and validity, and lists mobile top-ups and bundles for operators in 150+ countries, such as Airtel, Jio, Telcel and MTN. When you pick a plan, Slashtel gives you a secure checkout link; you pay on slashtel.com and receive your eSIM QR code or top-up confirmation by email. No account needed.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接为您的旅行寻找eSIM或为境外预付费手机充值。
Slashtel为190多个目的地提供实时数据套餐信息，包含价格、数据量和有效期，并列出150多个国家运营商的手机充值套餐，例如Airtel、Jio、Telcel和MTN。
选择套餐后，Slashtel将提供安全结账链接；您在slashtel.com支付后，可通过邮件接收eSIM二维码或充值确认信息。
无需账户。

payload.name: Adam Vacations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adam Vacations helps travelers search and book one-way and roundtrip flights with a simple, easy-to-use experience. The platform focuses on helping users find competitive airfare options across routes, making trip planning faster and more convenient. Whether you're booking a quick one-way journey or a complete roundtrip itinerary, Adam Vacations is designed to make flight booking straightforward and budget-friendly.
payload.longDescription: Adam Vacations 通过简单易用的体验，帮助旅行者搜索和预订单程及往返航班。平台着重帮助用户在不同航线上寻找具有竞争力的票价，让旅行规划更快速、更方便。无论预订短暂的单程旅行，还是完整的往返行程，Adam Vacations 都致力于让机票预订简单且经济实惠。

payload.name: Flight Queue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlightQueue answers practical airport questions with live data for 8,000+ airports. Users can check the security wait at an airport right now, get a forecast for a departure later this week, work out when to leave for a specific flight, see current FAA ground stops and delay programs, check EU Entry/Exit System border queues across Schengen, look up lounges and terminals, read aviation weather, and compare airlines on mishandled baggage. Users can also report the wait they actually experienced, which feeds the shared prediction model, and set an alert for when a wait crosses a threshold.
payload.longDescription: FlightQueue通过实时数据解答8000+机场的实用问题。用户可实时查看机场安检排队情况，获取本周晚些时候出发航班的预测信息，计算特定航班的出发时间，查看当前FAA地面停飞指令和延误计划，查看申根区欧盟入境/出境系统排队情况，查询休息室和航站楼信息，阅读航空天气报告，并比较各航空公司在行李处理方面的表现。用户还可上报实际体验的排队时间，为共享预测模型提供数据，并设置当排队时间超过阈值时的提醒。

payload.name: Brek - Hotel Wholesale Booking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wholesale hotel rates. Open to everyone. Booking hotels with the private wholesale rate, with transparent markups on Brek.
payload.longDescription: 酒店批发价，人人均可预订。通过 Brek 以私人批发价预订酒店，价格加价公开透明。

payload.name: AFerry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, compare and book ferries from 100+ operators 4000+ crossings worldwide using a marketplace established in 2000
payload.longDescription: 通过成立于 2000 年的交易平台，搜索、比较和预订全球 100+ 家运营商的 4000+ 条渡轮航线

payload.name: Parks Open
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find BC Parks campsites that fit your dates, rig, and site needs, and check live day-pass status by park, access area, and time slot. Compare complete-stay availability, park calendars, weather, and official advisories, then open the official BC Parks search flow. Results include observation times and source links. Parks Open is independent and never selects, books, holds, or takes payment for campsites or passes.
payload.longDescription: 查找符合日期、车辆和营位需求的 BC Parks 露营地，并按公园、入口区域和时段查看实时日票状态。比较完整住宿可用性、公园日历、天气和官方公告，然后打开 BC Parks 官方搜索流程。结果包含观测时间和来源链接。Parks Open 独立运行，从不选择、预订、保留或收取露营地或门票费用。

payload.name: PackRat
payload.description: 规划旅行并更聪明地打包
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PackRat helps outdoor travelers plan trips and build better packing lists. Search a large catalog of outdoor gear by keyword or natural language, compare products on weight and price, and assemble packing lists that are analyzed for total weight with a base, worn, and consumable breakdown. Ask for lighter alternatives to the heaviest items, find gaps for a specific trip, check the near-term weather forecast for a destination, browse outdoor guides, and save trips and packs to a PackRat account that syncs with the mobile app.
payload.longDescription: PackRat 帮助户外旅行者规划行程并制作更完善的打包清单。按关键词或自然语言搜索大量户外装备目录，按重量和价格比较产品，并创建打包清单，分析总重量以及基础装备、穿戴装备和消耗品的重量明细。询问最重物品的轻量替代品，为特定行程查找遗漏装备，查看目的地近期天气预报，浏览户外指南，还可以将行程和装备清单保存到 PackRat 账户并与移动应用同步。

payload.name: Remjet
payload.description: 保存拍摄地点，规划旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Remjet by StudioTHM helps photographers save locations, organize them into lists, and plan photography trips from ChatGPT. Pins created through the plugin stay private until the user chooses to publish them from Remjet.
payload.longDescription: StudioTHM 推出的 Remjet 可帮助摄影师保存地点、整理成列表，并通过 ChatGPT 规划摄影之旅。通过该插件创建的标记会保持私密，直到用户选择从 Remjet 发布。

payload.name: Hotel Liabeny
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hotel Liabeny Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Hotel Liabeny, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Hotel Liabeny?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.
payload.longDescription:
Hotel Liabeny Assistant 可帮助宾客通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见预订事务。
用户可以询问 Hotel Liabeny 的客房、设施、酒店服务、政策以及入住和退房时间。助手还可以查询客房空房情况并列出可选房间附加服务。
如果宾客已有预订，提供所需预订信息后，助手可以检索预订详情，并帮助修改或取消现有预订。
宾客需要帮助时，助手也可协助创建新预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
你可以这样提问：
“Hotel Liabeny 的入住时间是几点？”
“下周末有空房吗？”
“显示可订房型。”
“修改我的预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”
“联系酒店，协助处理我的预订。”

注意：某些预订操作可能需要提供预订代码或宾客信息等预订详情。

payload.name: 이심통
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 여행 국가, 기간, 데이터 사용량에 맞춰 이심통의 실물 USIM 상품을 추천합니다. 블로그 속 여행 통신 팁, 개통 방법, 구글맵 활용 정보, 여행 준비 글도 함께 찾아드립니다. 데이터는 든든하게, 여행 준비는 가볍게 챙겨가세요.
payload.longDescription: 根据旅行目的地、时长和数据用量，为你推荐 이심통 的实体 USIM 商品。还可查找博客中的旅行通信技巧、开通方法、Google 地图使用信息和旅行准备文章。数据用得放心，旅行准备更轻松。

payload.name: Black Car Service
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get SUV fare estimates and check tentative availability for San Francisco Bay Area rides, including SFO, OAK and SJC airport transfers, point-to-point trips, and hourly service for up to seven passengers. Continue to our website to review your trip and complete booking and payment. Quotes exclude optional gratuity, and availability is not guaranteed until confirmed.
payload.longDescription: 获取旧金山湾区乘车的SUV费用估算，查看SFO、OAK和SJC机场接送、点对点行程以及最多7人乘坐的小时服务暂定可用性。继续访问我们的网站查看行程详情并完成预订与支付。报价不包含可选小费，可用性需经确认后才可保障。

payload.name: Kratons
payload.description: 西班牙、葡萄牙和摩洛哥旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kratons is a boutique destination management company and travel agency based in Madrid that designs and operates tailor-made private trips in Spain, Portugal and Morocco: hotels, private guides, drivers and transfers, rail and flight tickets, restaurants and experiences, with full itinerary design and on-the-ground operation.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can:
- Explain who Kratons is, where it operates, which languages it works in and how it prices trips (one package price per trip, prepared by a human advisor; no public price list).
- List the destinations where Kratons currently offers tours and tickets, and search those experiences by country, city or keyword.
- Browse published sample itineraries (destination, duration, day-by-day outline) to start planning from.
- Submit a structured proposal request on behalf of a traveller or a travel agent (destinations, dates, travellers, budget, interests) and return a reference.
- Check the status of a submitted proposal request by its reference.

Nothing is booked or paid inside ChatGPT. A proposal request goes to a human advisor at Kratons, who replies by e-mail within two business days. Prices and suppliers are never shown by the plugin.
payload.longDescription:
Kratons 是一家总部位于马德里的精品目的地管理公司和旅行社，为西班牙、葡萄牙和摩洛哥设计并运营量身定制的私人旅行：酒店、私人导游、司机和接送、铁路和机票、餐厅与体验，以及完整的行程设计和当地运营。

通过此插件，ChatGPT 可以：
- 说明 Kratons 是谁、运营地点、支持的语言，以及旅行如何定价（每次旅行一个套餐价，由人工顾问准备；没有公开价目表）。
- 列出 Kratons 当前提供旅游和票务的目的地，并按国家、城市或关键词搜索这些体验。
- 浏览已发布的示例行程（目的地、时长、逐日概览），以此开始规划。
- 代表旅行者或旅行代理提交结构化方案请求（目的地、日期、旅行者、预算、兴趣），并返回参考编号。
- 根据参考编号查询已提交方案请求的状态。

ChatGPT 内不会完成预订或付款。方案请求会发送给 Kratons 的人工顾问，顾问将在两个工作日内通过电子邮件回复。插件不会显示价格和供应商。

payload.name: SlickTrip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SlickTrip watches flight, hotel and seat prices and tells you when they move. Search flights and hotels with live prices, see the cheapest days on a calendar, and check which seats are open on a flight. Then set an alert: a specific fare, a hotel stay, a seat, or a bucket list for a route or a place with flexible dates. SlickTrip keeps checking and emails or texts you when the price drops or a seat opens. Searching works without an account; alerts need a free SlickTrip login. Booking happens on the airline's or hotel seller's own site, and every result opens on slicktrip.com fully configured.
payload.longDescription: SlickTrip 会监测航班、酒店和座位价格，并在价格变动时通知你。搜索航班和酒店，查看实时价格和日历上的最低价日期，并查询航班上哪些座位可选。然后设置提醒：指定票价、酒店住宿、座位，或针对某条航线或某个地点设置可灵活选择日期的旅行愿望清单。SlickTrip 会持续检查，并在价格下降或座位开放时通过电子邮件或短信通知你。无需账户即可搜索；设置提醒需要免费的 SlickTrip 登录账户。预订会在航空公司或酒店销售商自己的网站上完成，每项结果都会打开已配置好的 slicktrip.com 页面。

payload.name: Cortenoi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Scopri Corte Noi a Bitetto con un’esperienza informativa elegante e immediata: panoramica della struttura storica, servizi, camere e contatti ufficiali in un’unica app. Perfetta per conoscere l’ospitalità di Corte Noi e orientarti rapidamente su posizione e informazioni utili.
payload.longDescription: 通过优雅直观的信息体验，了解位于 Bitetto 的 Corte Noi：在一个应用中查看这处历史建筑的概况、服务、客房和官方联系方式。适合了解 Corte Noi 的待客服务，并快速查找位置和实用信息。

payload.name: Max Eats Out
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover restaurants and bars from Max Eats Out, an editorially curated guide of hand-picked venues across cities around the world. Search by city, cuisine, atmosphere, drinks & recommended orders and other features, explore individual venues, and ask conversational questions about where to eat and drink.

Max Eats Out is an editorial guide rather than a generic places database. Its recommendations reflect a private community of foodies & locals, visits and opinions, so coverage varies by city and is deliberately selective.

Use it to discover places for a particular meal or occasion, explore a city's coverage, or get more detail about a specific venue. The plugin provides read-only access to the public Max Eats Out catalogue and does not require a Max Eats Out account.
payload.longDescription:
从 Max Eats Out 发现餐厅和酒吧。这是一份经过编辑精选的指南，收录世界各地城市中精心挑选的场所。你可以按城市、菜系、氛围、饮品、推荐菜品和其他特点搜索，浏览具体场所，并以对话方式询问餐饮去处。

Max Eats Out 是一份编辑指南，而非通用地点数据库。推荐来自一个私密的美食爱好者和当地居民社群，以及他们的探访和观点，因此各城市的覆盖范围有所不同，并且经过刻意筛选。

你可以用它寻找适合某顿饭或某种场合的去处、了解某城市的覆盖范围，或深入了解特定场所。该插件只读访问 Max Eats Out 的公开目录，无需 Max Eats Out 账户。

payload.name: Lion Travel 雄獅旅遊
payload.description: 搜索团体旅游、机票、住宿和票券
payload.summaryOriginal: 搜尋團體旅遊、機票、住宿與票券
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
透過自然語言搜尋雄獅旅遊提供的團體行程、機票、住宿與票券。只要輸入目的地、旅遊日期、人數、預算或偏好，即可探索並比較合適的旅遊產品，查看價格、日期與行程重點，並前往雄獅旅遊官方網站確認最新商品資訊及完成訂購。
搜尋結果中的價格、機位、房況、票券庫存、行程內容及訂購條件，皆以雄獅旅遊官方網站當下顯示的資訊為準。
payload.longDescription:
使用自然语言搜索雄狮旅遊提供的团体行程、机票、住宿和票券。输入目的地、旅行日期、人数、预算或偏好，即可探索并比较合适的旅行产品，查看价格、日期和行程亮点，并前往雄狮旅遊官方网站确认最新商品信息并完成订购。
搜索结果中的价格、机位、房况、票券库存、行程内容及订购条件，均以雄狮旅遊官方网站当时显示的信息为准。

payload.name: ChillMaps: NA Drink Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NA Drink Finder is the world's largest database of venues serving NA drinks.  The app maps over one million bars, restaurants, breweries, and stores worldwide that offer non-alcoholic beer, mocktails, wine, and spirits, making it easy to find options wherever you are.

NA Drink Finder is built for anyone exploring mindful drinking, including Dry January, sobriety, health reasons, or personal preference.
payload.longDescription:
NA Drink Finder 是全球最大的提供非酒精饮品的场所数据库。该应用标注了全球超过一百万家酒吧、餐厅、酿酒厂和商店，提供无酒精啤酒、无酒精鸡尾酒、葡萄酒和烈酒选项，让您随时随地轻松找到选择。

NA Drink Finder 专为探索有意识饮酒方式的人群设计，包括参与 Dry January（戒酒一月）活动、追求戒酒状态、出于健康考虑或个人偏好者。

payload.name: Klook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Klook helps you discover and book things to do wherever you are. Describe what you're looking for — your destination, dates, and interests — and get a list of relevant options with important details like price, reviews, and photos.

When you're ready to book, tap "View on Klook" to open the full listing and complete your booking.

From tours, experiences, attractions, and more, Klook brings together what you need in one place, making it easy to plan ahead or decide on the go.
payload.longDescription:
Klook 帮助你随时随地发现并预订活动。描述你的需求——目的地、日期和兴趣——即可获取相关选项列表及价格、评论和照片等重要信息。

准备好预订时，点击“View on Klook”打开完整商品信息并完成预订。

从旅行团、体验、景点等项目中，Klook 将所需信息汇集于一处，让你轻松提前规划或随时决定。

payload.name: TRIP PLANNER Travel Itinerary
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your trip planning request into a day-by-day itinerary, shown at a glance in the neatly organized Travel Vibes Scratchpad widget while the planning continues in the chat.

Use it when you need a travel plan, an itinerary, a day-by-day schedule, or things to do in a place: a city break, weekend getaway, long weekend, sightseeing, layover, trip with kids, road trip, day trip, multi-day travel, multi-city route, multi-country trip, Euro trip, vacation, holiday, honeymoon, multi-generational and family trip, group trip, solo trip, health and wellness trip, sport or festival trip, business meeting travel or business trip.

Share your trip plan with your travel companions by link, or download it as a PDF or an image. Get an email for all your travel planning confirmations. Use Travel Vibes to understand what to do each day, places to see, local tips, food and restaurants, and where to stay. Find hotels and flights, build a budget and keep track of travel finances, keep an event and activity calendar, choose dates, and build travel routes and flight routes. Get help on the level of a high-class travel agent or travel guide.

People using our app have traveled across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, and even Antarctica. Travel Vibes has helped plan trips to France, Spain, the United States, Turkey, Italy, Mexico, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, Greece, Thailand, Austria, Saudi Arabia, Portugal, Malaysia, the Netherlands, India, Canada, Poland, Vietnam, Morocco, Croatia, South Korea, Egypt, Indonesia, Hungary, Singapore, Switzerland, Albania, Tunisia, Uzbekistan, Belgium, South Africa, Sweden, Bulgaria, the Dominican Republic, Australia, Colombia, Brazil, Cambodia, Bahrain, Argentina, Ireland, the Philippines, Chile, Jordan, Georgia, Slovenia, Qatar and many other countries.
payload.longDescription:
将你的旅行规划需求转化为按天安排的行程，并在规划仍于聊天中继续时，通过布局清晰的 Travel Vibes Scratchpad 小组件一览行程。

当你需要旅行计划、行程安排、逐日计划或某地活动建议时都可使用：城市短途游、周末度假、长周末、观光、中途停留、带孩子旅行、自驾游、一日游、多日旅行、多城市路线、多国旅行、欧洲之旅、假期、蜜月、多代同堂及家庭旅行、团体旅行、独自旅行、健康养生之旅、体育或节庆旅行、商务会议出行或商务旅行。

你可以通过链接与旅伴分享旅行计划，或将其下载为 PDF 或图像。获取所有旅行规划确认信息的电子邮件。使用 Travel Vibes 了解每天可以做什么、值得参观的地点、本地提示、美食和餐厅，以及住宿地点。查找酒店和航班、制定预算并跟踪旅行财务、维护活动日历、选择日期，以及规划旅行路线和航线。获取媲美高级旅行顾问或导游的帮助。

我们的应用用户曾前往欧洲、亚洲、非洲、美洲，甚至南极洲旅行。Travel Vibes 曾帮助规划法国、西班牙、美国、土耳其、意大利、墨西哥、英国、德国、日本、希腊、泰国、奥地利、沙特阿拉伯、葡萄牙、马来西亚、荷兰、印度、加拿大、波兰、越南、摩洛哥、克罗地亚、韩国、埃及、印度尼西亚、匈牙利、新加坡、瑞士、阿尔巴尼亚、突尼斯、乌兹别克斯坦、比利时、南非、瑞典、保加利亚、多米尼加共和国、澳大利亚、哥伦比亚、巴西、柬埔寨、巴林、阿根廷、爱尔兰、菲律宾、智利、约旦、格鲁吉亚、斯洛文尼亚、卡塔尔以及许多其他国家/地区的旅行。

payload.name: ChecklistIQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travel Checklist Builder creates a FREE, personalized travel checklist based on your trip details and preferences.

Tell us where you’re going, how long you’ll be away, who’s traveling, and what activities you plan — and we’ll generate a clear, organized packing and planning list you can view, edit, and print.

This tool helps you:
- Prepare for any trip with tailored essentials
- Include climate, activity, and group-specific items
- Get pre-departure reminders and packing categories
- Print or export your checklist for offline use

No generic lists — every checklist is customized to your trip profile.
payload.longDescription:
Travel Checklist Builder 会根据你的行程详情和偏好，创建一份免费的个性化旅行清单。

告诉我们你要去哪里、离开多久、有哪些人同行，以及计划参加哪些活动——我们就会生成一份清晰有序的行李和行程准备清单，你可以查看、编辑和打印。

此工具可帮助你：
- 根据行程定制必需品，为任何旅行做好准备
- 纳入适合气候、活动和同行群体的物品
- 获取出发前提醒和行李分类
- 打印或导出清单，以便离线使用

告别千篇一律的清单——每份清单都根据你的行程资料定制。

payload.name: Worldschedule
payload.description: 搜索并预订巴士/火车票
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your global companion for bus and train travel. Skip the complex search filters. Just say where you want to go, and it handles the rest using the network of 2,500+ carriers covering 40K+ cities & airports in 100+ countries. From airport transfers to cross-country rail, find the best routes and book your tickets instantly in one seamless conversation.
- Global Coverage: Access thousands of bus and train routes worldwide
- Simple Booking: Go from "Where should I go?" to a confirmed ticket in a few moments
- Live Data: Get real-time pricing and availability directly from the carriers
payload.longDescription:
为你提供全球巴士和火车出行服务。无需使用复杂筛选条件，只需说出目的地，其余工作交由服务处理。它接入覆盖 100+ 个国家、40K+ 个城市和机场的 2,500+ 家承运商网络。从机场接驳到跨国铁路，都能在一次流畅对话中找到合适路线并即时订票。
- 全球覆盖：访问世界各地数千条巴士和火车路线
- 轻松预订：几分钟内从“我该去哪里？”到确认车票
- 实时数据：直接从承运商获取实时价格和可用情况
